answer: Hold a random audit lottery: every epoch a few identities are picked for a deep review of their work history, costs, and endorsements. A velvet glove hides an iron rule, because any identity that fails the audit forfeits its stake and every identity sharing its funding trail. Pigment marks the whole cluster, not just one alias, so the expected loss from one bad relic of a farm outweighs the gains of a hundred quiet clones. Honest agents pass easily because their history is real.
